verdict.rationale: E2B documents lifecycle-event webhooks that send notifications to an external web server when certain sandbox lifecycle events occur. That gives you an event trigger, but you must build the rule logic and the resulting actions yourself on your own server. Sandbox timeouts are the only other automatic behavior, and they are fixed system behavior rather than user-defined rules. Missing for 10: native rule definition or a trigger-action engine, event types beyond sandbox lifecycle, built-in actions run on events, filtering or conditions on events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
